{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is neutral or negative).",
    "Adjust downward if sentiment history shows persistent negative sentiment (e.g., multiple -0.20 or -0.25 entries).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment shifts from positive to neutral/negative (e.g., 0.00 → -0.20).",
    "Avoid overreacting to recent highs: if last 3 days are above 75, cap forecast at 74.5 unless sentiment strongly bullish.",
    "If sentiment history includes 0.33 or 0.50, slightly increase downward bias to reflect caution.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, reduce volatility in early periods if sentiment is weak (e.g., 0.00 for 5+ days)."
  ]
}
